flows.name: User Login
flows.trigger: User enters credentials in HRMS_LOGIN.fmb and clicks BTN_LOGIN

steps.notes: Passes p_email, p_password. Returns p_emp_id, p_session_id. Password NOT verified against hash — known bug.
Sets Oracle Forms global variables from authenticate output.
OPEN_FORM('HRMS_MENU') called after successful authenticate.
Called per menu item: PAYROLL, ADMIN, REPORTS. Disables items without permission.

flows.security_notes: Password transmitted cleartext from form. No account lockout. authenticate may return first row if duplicate email (MIN(EMP_ID) fallback).

flows.name: Hire New Employee
flows.trigger: HR user creates new employee record in HRMS_EMPLOYEE.fmb and commits

steps.notes: Fetches next employee ID.
Generates EMP_NUMBER. KNOWN BUG: race condition — no SELECT FOR UPDATE; duplicate numbers possible under concurrent load.
Client-side validation. Email regex differs from server-side — known drift.
Trigger auto-defaults ACTIVE_FLAG, CREATED_BY, CREATED_DATE. Validates hire date max 180 days future (form allows only 90 — conflict).
Creates initial salary record, end-dates any prior active salary.
PRAGMA AUTONOMOUS_TRANSACTION audit entry in AUDIT_LOG.
Queues two notifications: welcome email to employee, alert to HR. AUTONOMOUS_TRANSACTION — never fails caller.
Passes emp_id, leave_type_id, start_date, end_date, notes.
Validates leave type exists, checks REQUIRES_APPROVAL flag.
Validates employee tenure (must be active, hire date checks).
Overlap detection. KNOWN BUG: ignores half-days.
Checks available balance = OPENING + ACCRUED - USED + ADJUSTMENT - PENDING.
Inserts request with STATUS=PENDING or AUTO_APPROVED if REQUIRES_APPROVAL='N'.
Notifies manager for pending approval, or notifies employee if auto-approved.

flows.name: Run Payroll
flows.trigger: Payroll administrator clicks BTN_CALCULATE in HRMS_PAYROLL.fmb for a PENDING run

steps.notes: Only callable when PAYROLL_RUNS.STATUS = PENDING.
Locks the run record.
Row-by-row cursor over active employees. PERFORMANCE RISK: no set-based processing.
Called per employee. Uses hard-coded ELEMENT_IDs 1,100,101,102,103.
2024 brackets hard-coded. Annualizes/de-annualizes per pay period.
Flat rates by state; ELSE branch defaults to 5%.
SS wage base $168,600 @ 6.2%; Medicare 1.45% + 0.9% above $200,000.
Inserts computed pay elements per employee. YTD fields hard-coded 0 — known bug.
Partial commits mean partial failures leave DB in inconsistent state.
Separate step; only CALCULATED status allowed. Requires PAYROLL APPROVE permission.

flows.name: Generate GL Journal Feed
flows.trigger: Scheduled job or manual call to PKG_INTEGRATION.generate_gl_journal

steps.notes: Queries approved payroll runs for the given period.
Opens pipe-delimited flat file for write.
Writes Header row.
Writes one Detail row per payroll line item.
Writes Trailer row with record count.
Closes file. FTP to GL system is external — not implemented in code.

flows.known_issues: FTP credentials stored cleartext in SYSTEM_PARAMETERS. FTP step itself is not in code — external process assumed.

flows.name: Process Notification Queue
flows.trigger: DBMS_SCHEDULER job every 5 minutes calls PKG_NOTIFICATION.process_queue

steps.notes: Scheduler job definition not found in source; existence inferred from package comment.
Fetches up to 50 PENDING notifications.
Opens new SMTP connection per email. PERFORMANCE RISK: no connection pooling.
Marks sent. On failure sets STATUS=FAILED, increments RETRY_COUNT.
